miami-whitewater-forest: A separate Great Parks alert, dated November 11, 2026–February 12, 2027, warns of possible intermittent Shaker Trace Loop closures for the golf-course irrigation project. Crews are to be on site for safety; this notice is separate from the November paving work.
Shaker Trace Loop Closures Start: November 11, 2026 End: February 12, 2027 Construction Miami Whitewater Forest

Due to the Miami Whitewater Forest Golf Course Irrigation project, there may be intermittent closures to the Shaker Trace Loop trail. Crews will be onsite to ensure safety for both work crews and trail users.
